$comment: The metadata beside the Active ring in the 1Password item, not the ring.
The rings live in the item's own secret fields; nothing secret goes in here.
Active describes what is deployed, so its phase is always 'deployed' and it
always names the deployment that carried it.

This entry's deploymentId is what a rotation run compares evidence against (-DeploymentId). A match there is a self-report measured against this hand-typed value, not proof of origin: section 2.2 rev.19.

fingerprint.$comment: How this is computed is NOT decided; see section 6, item 2.
fingerprint.value: <the fingerprint of the material this entry describes>
